class Solution:
    def isPossibleToSplit(self, nums: List[int]) -> bool:
        # Count frequency of each number
        from collections import Counter
        freq = Counter(nums)
        
        # Check if any number appears more than 2 times
        # Because each number can appear at most once in each half
        # So maximum allowed frequency is 2
        for count in freq.values():
            if count > 2:
                return False
        
        # Also check if the number of distinct elements is sufficient
        # Since each half must have length n/2 and contain distinct elements,
        # we need at least n/2 distinct elements for each half
        # But since we can distribute numbers that appear twice (one in each half),
        # the only constraint is that no number appears more than twice
        # Actually, the frequency > 2 check is sufficient
        
        return True
```
